_comment: Two entries, so `a.js` and `w.js` are in one common chunk. `main.js` defers `a.js`, and `b.js` imports `a.js`, then `w.js`. With `chunkModulesOrder: 'moduleId'`, the chunk does not move `w.js` to a new chunk. Thus the chunk runs `a.js` at load, at its place, as the build without `import defer` does.
